analysis: Examined head text of docs/provider/cli-reference.md lines 1213-2130. Changed lines in these units: 1213 (setup with --disk runs installer without plan; --disk offered only when status --json has disks), 1249-1258 (plan parsing of disks entries; failed plan with --disk stops setup with installer stderr and exit status, no fallback to estimate), 1335 (status disks member rendering, Work disk lines). These are documentation of the TB-013/T-061 sandbox CLI/add-on command contract: the CLI passes operator-supplied disk paths to the add-on installer it already runs as the Mac owner (A-019). No new privilege, network endpoint, or coordinator/provider trust change is described; the installer source and fetch controls (https --server without credentials, line ~1077) are unchanged. Failing closed on refused disks (1256-1258) is conservative. Displaying add-on-reported disk paths/detail is local self-reported output, consistent with TB-012/TB-013 self-reported status. Remaining lines (doctor, verify, models, benchmark, update, beta, fan, login/logout, unenroll, local, logs) are unchanged in this PR per complete range map. Integration question: the --disk argument validation (patch lines 1094-1109, 1117-1132: absolutization, statfs, /Volumes/<name> volume check) is in another batch; confirm the CLI passes paths as argv (not shell-interpolated) to install.sh and that this does not alter T-061 assumptions. Work disks are add-on VM storage, distinct from the prefix-cache storage covered by T-041; no T-041 change.
